question: What practice is commonly identified as the preparatory rite in the world?
premises: Worship of the five limbs is named.
The term puraścaraṇa is applied to it.
This identification is said to hold in the world.
inference: In the world, worship of the five limbs is called the preparatory rite.
plain_english: In the world, worship of the five limbs is called the preparatory rite.
